snippet.title: This Mod Is An Absolute Masterpiece | "Doki Doki: Exit Music Redux" Mod (Full Playthrough)
snippet.description:
"Doki Doki: Literature Club" (Exit Music Redux) Mod.

Mod created by: Wretched Team ( https://wretchedteam.com/ ).

I'm loss at words... This mod is insane. The amount of effort that went into this, every little detail, everything looks full of life, the writing, the music. This is a masterpiece. I absolutely loved MC's and Monika's characterization in this mod, it was brilliant.

I don't know if the creators will read this, but this is beautiful. You're all awesome. I can't thank you enough for putting so much effort and time into this. It really paid of. Thanks for making this and I hope you keep making more. You're awesome, Wretched Team.

I'll upload the bonus stories in the next days. Can't wait to play it.

Thanks for watching! More DDLC Mods in my channel.
